check.description: Colour is not the only means of conveying information, indicating an action, or distinguishing a visual element (pair with text/icon/shape).

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects). Recurs as a component anti-pattern: status/selection/error must not rely on colour alone.
